newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom plans acquisitions for growth - chairman.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom plans acquisitions for growth - chairman.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate, the DRB-HICOM Group is looking for acquisitions in automotive, finance and construction business for faster growth, its chairman Saleh Sulong said in an interview on Wednesday.
"We are looking at acquisitions with a view to expanding rapidly," he told Reuters. The conglomerate is made up of Diversified Resources Bhd and Hicom Holdings Bhd .
"We are looking at automotive, financial and construction," said the group chairman, now in his third month in office.
He said the group's desire to grow fast could also bring its various companies to the market for funds soon.
"I wouldn't dismiss the possibility in the near future, bearing in mind the magnitude of the funding required," Saleh said.

"Nevertheless, a sizeable portion of it (funds) will be coming from within because we have been registering good profit as of late. I think we will not be so much bogged down, or impeded too much by financial costs," he said.
He said the group was also continuing with the policies that were put in place during the tenure of late chairman Yahaya Ahmad, who died in a helicopter crash in March.
"I have been involved with this group for the same period of time as (late) Tan Sri Yahaya. He was the chairman and I was the group managing director.
"So there was no necessity for change because I have been involved in the formulation of policies and strategies," he said.
"It is my third month (in office). The job is getting easier by the day," Saleh said.
But, there was a need to speed up implementation of some of the group's plans to maintain competitiveness as the domestic market opens further, he said.
The DRB-Hicom group also controls the national car maker, Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) and car distribution and banking company Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd.
